name: Fair districts (ReCom)
description: Partisan-blind districts generated with ReCom (GerryChain) on 2020 census tracts. States not yet generated are absent.

elections.label: 2020 President
elections.source: VEST 2020 precinct results (Harvard Dataverse), allocated to 2020 census blocks by population

elections.label: 2024 President
elections.source: The New York Times 2024 presidential precinct map, allocated to 2020 census blocks by population. Alaska (at-large): statewide MEDSL totals. Parts of OK and SD missing.
elections.credit: 2024 precinct data: The New York Times

elections.label: 2022 House (inferred)
elections.source: 2020 presidential results shifted per state by the 2020→2022 change in the Democratic two-party share of the House vote (FEC certified results, races with both a Democrat and a Republican). Turnout is 2020 presidential turnout.

elections.label: 2026 House (inferred, unofficial)
elections.source: 2024 presidential results shifted by the 2024→2026 change in the Democratic two-party share of the House vote; per state where pipeline/inputs/house_votes.csv has both years, else national. 2026 counts are unofficial (see that file). Turnout is 2024 presidential turnout.
